entities.summary: Manepalli Narayanarao Venkatachaliah was the 25th Chief Justice of India, serving from 1993 to 1994. He currently serves as the Chancellor of Sri Sathya Sai Institute of Higher Learning and on the advisory board of Foundation for Restoration of National Values, a society established in 2008 that strives to restore "national and cultural values" of India.
